correctness.rationale: Every isotone endpoint-fixing Boolean function is a positive disjunctive normal form. For two such functions the disagreement set is order-convex, and conversely the explicit upset pair (up D, up D minus D) realizes every endpoint-avoiding convex D; the empty case is separate. Inclusion-exclusion and a rank-three interior chain give the first cutoff. Constructing any cardinality upset yields each fixed-arity agreement probability. The independent brute-force and recursive enumerations exhaust all 166 four-variable functions and all 27556 ordered pairs; complete convex mask enumeration independently checks all 3605 possible masks. General statements are proved rather than inferred from computations.

value.rationale: Cardó’s spectrum-density example for the exact positive two-operation algebra does not give the stronger all-arity equality-set geometry or fixed-arity exact spectrum. The all-arity realization identifies a natural sharp four-input expressivity cutoff (3605 of 16384 potential internal disagreement masks), and the weighted 15-cell four-input distribution is a motivated exact refinement of natural equation-agreement/Hamming statistics. The known unweighted convex set count is explicitly not claimed as new.
